profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: I am a full stack engineer with a degree from Northeastern University looking for remote or hybrid employment in the Greater Boston Area.  I am passionate about making user-friendly products that provide tangible value in a comfortable and flexible work environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked as a contracted software engineer supporting CDC public health programs and data systems

- Designed, developed, and maintained secure, scalable applications used for disease surveillance and reporting

- Supported legacy system modernization and cloud migration initiatives

- Ensured compliance with federal standards (e.g., HIPAA, FISMA, NIST, Section 508)

- Improved system reliability, performance, and data quality through monitoring and optimization

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Enhanced the functionality of the Cost Intelligence product, enabling seamless access and improved data accessibility for in-house analysts.
- Transformed a large-scale data collection process, collaborating with thousands of electromagnetic sensors across the US and Europe to monitor the electrical grid efficiently.
- Led the overhaul of an antiquated data processing and storage system utilized by analysts, facilitating the recording and analysis of production and material flow for various metals and mining processes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained customer-facing marketing components in React.js and PHP on a cross-platform team alongside mobile app developers
- Collaborated across business and engineering teams to improve customer experience and react to evolving privacy standards
- Lead the initiative to move towards engineer ownership of code quality by electing to be the first to learn the quality process and apply it to the work of the team
- Implemented numerous unit tests to increase code coverage by 40% for the app growth team and ensure quality across Javascript and PHP codebases

positions.title: Software Engineer -- Contract
positions.description:
Built and maintained Web Applications used to create and maintain small businesses' online presence.
Created front end environments in the Vue framework, and created backend microservices in .NET Core.
Collaborated with multiple teams in an agile/SCRUM work environment.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer -- Contract
positions.description:
Created and designed an internal website utilizing Docusign API 
Built full stack website from Flask and MySQL 
Utilized Jinja, Bootstrap, and jQuery to self design pages on site

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer -- Contract
positions.description:
Created and maintained automated test suites for the iOS team in an AGILE environment
Developed new Javascript-based test automation framework
Created and ran manual test suites
